breakfast.name: Italian Baked Eggs with Spinach and Tomato
breakfast.preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Sauté spinach and tomatoes in olive oil. Add ricotta, salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning. Transfer to oven-safe ramekins. Crack an egg into each ramekin. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until eggs are cooked to your liking.
breakfast.nutritionalBenefits: Provides protein, iron, vitamins, and calcium, keeping you full and energized.
breakfast.healthNotes: A balanced breakfast that is relatively low in calories and high in nutrients.

lunch.name: Whole Wheat Pasta Salad with Grilled Chicken and Pesto
ingredients: 1/4 cup pesto (basil pesto, avoid lemon juice)
lunch.preparation: Combine cooked pasta, grilled chicken, cherry tomatoes, and mozzarella balls in a bowl. Toss with pesto and olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.
lunch.nutritionalBenefits: Provides a good source of protein, complex carbohydrates, and healthy fats for sustained energy.
lunch.healthNotes: A balanced and satisfying lunch that can be prepared in advance.

dinner.name: Baked Salmon with Roasted Vegetables (Italian Herbs)
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (broccoli, bell peppers, zucchini)
dinner.preparation: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss vegetables with olive oil, Italian herbs, salt, and pepper. Place salmon fillet and vegetables on a baking sheet. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until salmon is cooked through. Serve with sugar-free marinara sauce.
dinner.nutritionalBenefits: Provides omega-3 fatty acids, protein, and fiber-rich vegetables.
dinner.healthNotes: A healthy and delicious dinner that is rich in nutrients and low in calories.

snacks.name: Small Apple with a Handful of Almonds
snacks.preparation: Wash the apple and serve with a handful of almonds.
snacks.nutritionalBenefits: Provides fiber, vitamins, and healthy fats to keep you satisfied between meals.
snacks.healthNotes: A simple and healthy snack option.
